data.representation: equalized=1; center crop/pad 256; per-packet complex RMS; center=False; fs=25MHz

roles.U_use: index-only exact role audit; no U sample/label/training iterator

data.split_id: inherited deterministic physical source roles (historical protocol label 392005)
data.support_query_ref: No support adaptation; target query capsule only after source freeze
data.train_ratio_definition: rho_label=L_s/(L_s+U_s)=0.1; only L_s contributes to training
data.diagnostic_access: L_s 6300 only fits identity and auxiliary; V27000 read-only diagnostics, no selection; U not loaded; clean query after source freeze only.

checkpoint.initialization: Matched original E200 CE; fresh AdamW; no E40 descendant initialization

checkpoint.selection_rule: Final E40 for H0-H5/H8/H10; H6/H7/H9 fixed average E32/34/36/38/40 under preregistered tail cycles; V never selects

display_name: H0–H10 混合机制三种子 E40（33 实验）
description: 匹配原始 CE 旧门控 cosine E200，混合跨接收机对比、特征混合、SAM、尾部权重平均及有限 L/T；只用 L_s，逐行自动 clean。
authorization: 用户明确允许混合其他合规方法，每批多方案利用八卡；最新容量覆盖为每卡最多 3 进程（含其他任务），必要时减少。

code.commit_note: Exact execution commit inserted from immutable release at launch

permissions.claim_scope: Primary H9 and all preregistered arm means; complete-three-seed >=84%; descriptive paired contrasts, no confirmatory best-arm significance claim

execution.gpu_policy: All 8 GPUs; <=3 total processes/GPU including unrelated owners; >=12000MB free before launch, fewer if unavailable
execution.stop_rule: Technical failure retained; stop new pending submissions, healthy active rows complete; no automatic retry or low-performance stop

physical.objective: maximize fixed-parent true-IQ logit-margin drop; fixed classifier scale 30

temporal.phase_process: three smooth sine modes; clipped Gaussian coefficients

fractional_delay.operator: zero-pad 256 each side, FFT phase shift, crop original central 256
fractional_delay.zero_delay: exact value identity with differentiable delay path
fractional_delay.boundary_assumption: IQ outside observed 256-sample window is zero; sinc interpolation may ring near truncated edges
fractional_delay.scope: new fixed mild timing perturbation, not satellite/channel simulation or calibrated source error

physical.random: explicit private CPU generators; no global RNG consumption

physical_actions.coordinates: all four tanh(raw); temporal noise abs; then registered Linfinity normalization
physical_actions.fit: Original E200 frozen, fresh initialization, full L_s raw-margin pass then finite-risk pass
physical_actions.identity_training: frozen actions; no online optimizer, U, teacher or satellite
